title: Nebius adds VAST Data platform to its AI cloud

sources.quote: To meet the increasing demands of data-intensive enterprise AI customers, Nebius recognized the need to extend its AI Cloud with a fully featured, multi-tenant, high-performance data platform.
By integrating the cutting-edge VAST Data Platform, Nebius can provide unparalleled performance, scalability, and reliability for enterprises running advanced AI and machine learning workloads.

explain: Nebius, a GPU cloud provider, integrated VAST Data's storage platform into its AI cloud to serve enterprise customers, so Nebius pays VAST for the data layer. No price was disclosed.
